description: Which countries and territories does the UK Foreign Office publish travel advice for, and what is the slug for each? Lists every FCDO travel advice destination with its GOV.UK slug and the alternative names GOV.UK maps to it (for example Dubai to United Arab Emirates, Tenerife to Spain), so other travel advice tools can be called with the right slug. Optional search narrows the list. Live from the GOV.UK Content API; it returns names only, not the advice itself. (cost: 1 credit)

search.description: string, optional, filter by country name, slug or alternative name such as a city or island (case-insensitive); default lists all

name: travel_advice_countries
